common_name: Slender Greenthread / Edwards Plateau Greenthread / Navajo Tea
look_here_first: Start with the sparse foliage and perennial habit. Slender greenthread is a slender perennial with relatively few stem leaves, lower leaves often divided into 3–5 narrow segments, upper leaves simpler and threadlike, and yellow-rayed heads on long peduncles.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: yellow ray florets around a yellow to brownish disk

lookalikes.differences: Compared with T. filifolium, T. simplicifolium is perennial and typically much more sparsely leafy, with fewer and less repeatedly divided stem leaves. T. filifolium is usually an annual with more consistently dissected threadlike foliage.
